senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. סָבָא III)to be filled, to have plenty, be satisfied.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 113b:11">Sabb. 113ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Ruth 2:14">Ruth II, 14</cite>) <he>ותאכל בעולם הזה ותִשְׂבַּע וכ׳</he> she (Israel) will eat in this world, will have plenty in the Messianic days, and leave over for the hereafter.
<cite ref="Sukkah 52b:6">Succ. 52ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="T00871"><he>רָעֵב</he> II</cite>; a. e.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 76">Gen. R. s. 76</cite>, end <he>כדי להַשְׂבִּיעַ עיניו וכ׳</he> in order to satisfy the eyes of the wicked man. Y. Keth. V, 30ᵇ <he>הִשְׂבִּיעָתוֹ</he>; Succ. l. c. <he>מַשְׂבִּיעוֹ</he>, v. <cite ref="T00871"><he>רָעֵב</he> II</cite>.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 29b:7">Ib. 29ᵇ</cite> <he>אדם עשוי שלא להשביע את עצמו</he> man is wont not to declare himself wealthy (to disclaim wealth, by saying that he is in debt, even if he is not); <he>כשם שאדם … שלא להשביע את בניו</he> as man is wont to disclaim wealth for himself, so is he likely to disclaim it for his heirs (therefore an ante-mortem confession of indebtedness does not establish a claim against heirs).

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 29:8">Lev. R. s. 29</cite> (play on <he>השביעי</he>, <cite ref="Leviticus 23:24">Lev. XXIII, 24</cite>) <he>שהוא מש׳ בכל וכ׳</he> a month which is plentiful in every thing &c.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 14:12">Num. R. s. 14</cite> <he>עתיד להִשְׂתַּבּעַ</he>, v. <cite ref="O00549"><he>סִיג</he> I</cite>.
